title: Martian Mosaic
tagline: A gamified NFT Marketplace, focuses on preserving value of NFTs and NFT Projects
description:
My project, Martian Mosaic, delivers a novel NFT marketplace that provides NFT owners and fans with an immersive and gamified experience. NFT owners can earn the opportunity of liquidating their NFTs based on their market activity at the current floor price. These liquidated NFTs become available for minting at the same price, providing minters with the option to earn points in excess of what they would normally receive from trading activities.
Aside from the marketplace, we've created a dedicated minting platform where users may mint NFTs and earn more points. This qualifies them for the liquidation of their NFTs following trading activity in our marketplace.
To enhance financial security, we've built a one-of-a-kind mechanism that preserves a portion of newly generated cash from minting within the contract, protecting NFT owners from total financial loss. Furthermore, we've devised a floor pricing mechanism for listing NFTs, establishing a minimum and maximum threshold that will gradually increase over time.
Looking ahead in the future,  services like auctions, staking, and loans to further increase the functioning of our NFT marketplace. Martian Mosaic redefines the NFT trading experience by integrating gamification, user engagement, and financial security, providing a hopeful insight into the future of NFT ecosystems.
how_its_made:
Martian Mosaic blends cutting-edge technology to provide a unified user experience. started the project with the Scaffold-Eth starting app and built a responsive frontend with Next.js and TypeScript.
Solidity and Hardhat were used to power the implementation of smart contracts, which govern important marketplace functions such as NFT liquidation and point accumulation. We used The Graph to optimize data retrieval, resulting in efficient real-time data access. This technological convergence serves as the foundation of Martian Mosaic, which is revolutionizing NFT trading with a user-friendly, tech-savvy approach.
